---
title: "Help"
---

## For modelers using these profiles

Each profile follows the same 11-section template, so if you're looking
for something specific, jump straight to its section: **3. Administrative
Boundaries**, **6. Malaria Indicator Summary**, **8. Stratification Maps
/ SNT**, and **11. References** are usually the fastest way in.

## For country teams submitting a profile

See the [submission guide](https://github.com/map-data-engineering/COUNTRIES-PROFILES/tree/main/submissions)
for how to package and upload your country's profile — no git experience
needed, just a GitHub account.

## Something wrong on a page?

Open an issue on the [GitHub repo](https://github.com/map-data-engineering/COUNTRIES-PROFILES/issues)
or contact the MAP Data Engineering Team directly.
